<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">
<title>Proposal for Brandon Kmiotek | Faith Vision Media</title>
</head>
<body>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Big+Shoulders+Display:wght@700;800;900&family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@500&display=swap">
<style>
  /* Layout: one long black-and-cream scroll. Huge condensed headlines, one thin line of support under each. */
  :root{
    color-scheme:dark;
    --ink:#000000;
    --cream:#EEE9DD;
    --dim:#B4AEA0;
    --line:#34322D;
    --mid:#2B2924;
    --ink-dim:#3A372F;
    --display:'Big Shoulders Display','Arial Narrow',Impact,sans-serif;
    --sans:'Figtree','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;
    --mono:'IBM Plex Mono',ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{background:var(--ink);}
  body{margin:0;color:var(--cream);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:17px;line-height:1.4;}
  a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}
  a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--cream);outline-offset:4px;}
  .wrap{max-width:880px;margin:0 auto;padding-inline:24px;}

  .label{font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:500;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);}

  .topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding-block:24px;}
  .topbar .l{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;}
  .topbar img{width:56px;height:56px;display:block;}
  .topbar .r{text-align:right;}

  .hero{padding-block:48px 80px;}
  .for .name{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(36px,7vw,56px);line-height:1;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:10px;}
  .big{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(76px,20vw,172px);line-height:0.88;text-transform:uppercase;margin:28px 0 0;text-wrap:balance;}
  .tag{font-size:clamp(20px,3.6vw,26px);font-weight:500;color:var(--dim);margin-top:18px;}

  .stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:28px;border-top:3px solid var(--cream);padding-top:24px;margin-top:64px;}
  .stat{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;}
  .stat .n{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(84px,15vw,136px);line-height:0.85;}
  .stat .t{margin-top:14px;font-size:22px;font-weight:700;}
  .stat .s{margin-top:6px;font-size:16px;color:var(--dim);}

  .manage{margin-top:40px;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);padding:28px 32px;}
  .manage .mt{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(36px,7vw,52px);line-height:0.95;text-transform:uppercase;}

  .incl{margin-top:32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;}
  .chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;}
  .chip{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;border:1.5px solid var(--cream);padding:10px 16px;}

  .block{padding-block:88px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  .head{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(60px,14vw,120px);line-height:0.88;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 44px;}

  .rows{border-top:3px solid var(--cream);}
  .row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.25fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:24px;align-items:center;padding-block:24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .row .t{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(32px,6vw,46px);line-height:1;text-transform:uppercase;}
  .row .e{font-size:16px;color:var(--dim);}
  .formats{margin-top:36px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;}
  .strip{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);padding:22px 26px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px 24px;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(22px,4vw,30px);line-height:1;text-transform:uppercase;}

  .bands{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;}
  .band{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.3fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:24px;align-items:center;padding:36px 32px;border:2px solid var(--cream);}
  .band .ttl{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(60px,12vw,92px);line-height:0.9;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:4px;}
  .band p{margin:0;font-size:18px;}
  .band.b1{background:var(--ink);}
  .band.b2{background:var(--mid);border-color:var(--mid);}
  .band.b3{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);}
  .band.b3 .label{color:var(--ink-dim);}
  .rhythm{margin-top:48px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;}
  .rgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px;}
  .step{border-top:2px solid var(--cream);padding-top:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:0;}
  .step .v{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(24px,4.4vw,30px);line-height:1;text-transform:uppercase;}
  .step .d{font-size:15px;color:var(--dim);}

  .plans{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;}
  .plan{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;padding:30px;border:2px solid var(--cream);min-width:0;}
  .plan.rec{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);}
  .pill{font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:500;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 10px;border:1.5px solid var(--cream);}
  .plan.rec .pill{background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream);border-color:var(--ink);}
  .plan .pt{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:32px;line-height:1;text-transform:uppercase;}
  .price{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .price b{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(76px,15vw,100px);line-height:0.9;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
  .price span{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;}
  .plan .a{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;}
  .plan .b{font-size:16px;}
  .plan:not(.rec) .b{color:var(--dim);}

  .math{margin-top:48px;}
  .mrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:16px;padding-block:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  .mrow .k{font-size:18px;}
  .mrow .v{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap;}
  .mtotal{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 16px;padding-top:16px;border-top:3px solid var(--cream);}
  .mtotal .k{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(28px,5vw,36px);line-height:1;text-transform:uppercase;}
  .mtotal .v{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(44px,8vw,56px);line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
  .math .label{padding-bottom:12px;}

  .steps{margin-top:56px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px 14px;}
  .cta{margin-top:16px;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);padding:28px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:20px 32px;}
  .cta .label{color:var(--ink-dim);}
  .cta .phone{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(46px,10vw,64px);line-height:0.95;margin-top:4px;user-select:all;}
  .cta .alt{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;}
  .cta .mail{font-size:17px;font-weight:600;user-select:all;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}
  .cta .ig{font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:500;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:0.06em;}

  .foot{padding-block:32px 72px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;}

  @media (max-width:640px){
    .wrap{padding-inline:20px;}
    .hero{padding-block:32px 64px;}
    .stats{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:28px;margin-top:48px;}
    .stat{flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:20px;}
    .stat .n{min-width:108px;font-size:96px;}
    .stat .t{margin-top:0;font-size:20px;}
    .manage{padding:24px;}
    .block{padding-block:64px;}
    .row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:6px;padding-block:20px;}
    .band{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px;padding:28px 24px;}
    .rgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px;}
    .plans{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .plan{padding:26px 24px;}
    .cta{padding:24px;}
  }
</style>

<div class="wrap">

  <header class="topbar">
    <div class="l">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Faith Vision Media logo">
      <div class="label">Faith Vision Media</div>
    </div>
    <div class="label r">FVM-C01 · Oct 8, 2026</div>
  </header>

  <section class="hero">
    <div class="for">
      <div class="label">Proposal for</div>
      <div class="name">Brandon Kmiotek</div>
    </div>
    <h1 class="big">Stay in<br>the feed.</h1>
    <div class="tag">Fresh video every month, built around what the algorithm rewards.</div>

    <div class="stats">
      <div class="stat">
        <div class="n">8</div>
        <div>
          <div class="t">Videos a month</div>
          <div class="s">Talking head, BTS, UGC-style</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat">
        <div class="n">2</div>
        <div>
          <div class="t">Strategy calls a month</div>
          <div class="s">Week 1 and week 4, 30 min each</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat">
        <div class="n">15%</div>
        <div>
          <div class="t">Off listing content</div>
          <div class="s">Photo and video packages</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="manage">
      <div class="mt">Monthly content retainer</div>
    </div>

    <div class="incl">
      <div class="label">Every month also includes</div>
      <div class="chips">
        <div class="chip">Content calendar</div>
        <div class="chip">Captions + subtitles</div>
        <div class="chip">Vertical-ready</div>
        <div class="chip">Reels + Stories cuts</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="block" id="content">
    <h2 class="head">3 types of<br>content.</h2>
    <div class="rows">
      <div class="row"><div class="t">Talking head</div><div class="e">Market updates, tips and takes, straight to camera</div></div>
      <div class="row"><div class="t">Behind the scenes</div><div class="e">Walkthrough prep, staging, client moments</div></div>
      <div class="row"><div class="t">UGC-style</div><div class="e">Native-looking posts built for reach</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="formats">
      <div class="label">The mix</div>
      <div class="strip">
        <div>Planned monthly</div>
        <div>Adjusted by performance</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="block" id="timeline">
    <h2 class="head">3 months.<br>3 stages.</h2>
    <div class="bands">
      <div class="band b1">
        <div>
          <div class="label">Month 1</div>
          <div class="ttl">Learn</div>
        </div>
        <p>Strategy call, first shoots, first videos go out.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="band b2">
        <div>
          <div class="label">Month 2</div>
          <div class="ttl">Test</div>
        </div>
        <p>See what gets traction. More of that, less of the rest.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="band b3">
        <div>
          <div class="label">Month 3</div>
          <div class="ttl">Results</div>
        </div>
        <p>A steady rhythm, a video library, and real data for what comes next.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="rhythm">
      <div class="label">Every month</div>
      <div class="rgrid">
        <div class="step"><div class="label">Start</div><div class="v">Strategy call</div><div class="d">30 minutes</div></div>
        <div class="step"><div class="label">During</div><div class="v">8 videos</div><div class="d">Shot, edited, captioned</div></div>
        <div class="step"><div class="label">End</div><div class="v">Review call</div><div class="d">30 minutes</div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="block" id="investment">
    <h2 class="head">Two ways<br>to start.</h2>

    <div class="plans">
      <div class="plan rec">
        <div class="pill">Pay ahead</div>
        <div class="pt">3 months upfront</div>
        <div class="price"><b>$2,397</b><span>once</span></div>
        <div class="a">24 videos, one payment.</div>
        <div class="b">Then $799 / mo, month to month.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="plan">
        <div class="pill">No contract</div>
        <div class="pt">Month to month</div>
        <div class="price"><b>$799</b><span>/ mo</span></div>
        <div class="a">8 videos a month.</div>
        <div class="b">One month at a time.</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="math">
      <div class="label">The 3-month math</div>
      <div class="mrow"><div class="k">Content retainer · 8 videos</div><div class="v">$799 / mo</div></div>
      <div class="mrow"><div class="k">3 months × $799</div><div class="v">$2,397</div></div>
      <div class="mtotal"><div class="k">Paid upfront</div><div class="v">$2,397</div></div>
    </div>

    <div class="steps label">
      <span>01 Choose a plan</span><span>→</span><span>02 Pay to lock your start date</span><span>→</span><span>03 Month 1 begins</span>
    </div>

    <div class="cta">
      <div>
        <div class="label">Text or call</div>
        <a class="phone" href="tel:+17165606487">716-560-6487</a>
      </div>
      <div class="alt">
        <a class="mail" href="mailto:FaithVisions.media@gmail.com">FaithVisions.media@gmail.com</a>
        <a class="ig" href="https://instagram.com/faithvisionsmedia" target="_blank" rel="noopener">@faithvisionsmedia</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <footer class="foot label">
    <div>Faith Vision Media · Buffalo, NY</div>
    <div>Valid through Nov 8, 2026</div>
  </footer>

</div>

</body>
</html>
